nodes.label: config.json
nodes.rationale: Gitignored and mounted so Growatt tokens are not committed.

nodes.label: Remember me (90-day sign-in)
nodes.rationale: Suits a wall display; otherwise sign-in ends after 12 hours or browser close.

nodes.norm_label: salted scrypt password hashing and lockout

nodes.label: Sign in with Poodle House (OIDC SSO)
nodes.norm_label: sign in with poodle house (oidc sso)

nodes.label: Test-gated daily update
nodes.rationale: Only installs commits whose GitHub Test workflow passed; otherwise keeps current version.

nodes.label: TRUST_PROXY setting
nodes.rationale: Only trust X-Forwarded-* from known proxies so nobody can fake address to dodge lockout.

nodes.label: Dashboard two-column grid layout
nodes.rationale: HTML order matches visual order so keyboard/screen-reader order follows the screen; collapses to one column below 760px.

nodes.label: Sign-in card component
nodes.rationale: Layout follows the household's Mealie sign-in; pill primary because it is the page's only action.

nodes.label: Solar Flow Diagram (signature component)
nodes.rationale: Dashes animate via transform only so layout is never redone; static gradient fallback for reduced motion.

nodes.label: The 11px Floor Rule
nodes.rationale: No text below 11px at any width, including solar diagram on phones.

nodes.label: Cheap continuous effects / reduced motion
nodes.rationale: Runs on cheap always-on hardware: transform/opacity only, no continuous CPU/GPU cost.

nodes.label: The Glow-Means-Live Rule
nodes.rationale: Coloured glow only on currently active elements; glow is state, not decoration.

nodes.label: The Meaningful Flow Rule
nodes.rationale: Diagram colour encodes power source: green solar/load, cyan battery, coral grid.

nodes.label: The One Action Rule
nodes.rationale: Lime means act here / you are here; never decorative.

nodes.label: The Steady Numbers Rule
nodes.rationale: Refreshing numbers use tabular figures so they never jitter.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: The Morning Brief
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: the morning brief
nodes.rationale: Quiet glanceable daily briefing; weather and power first; dark calm page can sit on screen all day and dim at night without glaring.
